name: iQ3Corp Ltd
summary: iQ3Corp Ltd provides capital raising and corporate advisory services to listed and unlisted companies in the life science industry in Australia. The company operates through Consulting Services, and Shared Services segments. It offers advisory services on initial public offerings, listings, private equity, mergers and acquisitions, structured finance, strategic matters, restructuring and capital structure, capital raising, and corporate finance, as well as structured finance services. The company also provides sell-side, buy-side, and NSX nominated advisory services. It serves corporations, partnerships, institutions, governments, and individuals. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in Sydney, Australia.
